description:
Curate a NeurIPS-focused reading list from your Zotero library.

Your library contains 18 papers. Your goal is to:
1. Create a new top-level collection named exactly 'NeurIPS Preparation'.
2. Inspect the metadata of your papers to identify those published in 'Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems'.
3. Add ONLY those NeurIPS papers to your new collection (there should be 4).
4. Add the tag 'neurips-reading' to each of these 4 papers.
5. Create a standalone note inside the 'NeurIPS Preparation' collection titled 'Presentation Outline'.
6. In the note, write a brief outline (at least 150 characters) that references the titles of at least 2 of the papers you added.

Note: The collection name and tag must match exactly.

metadata.target_venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
target_papers: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
